text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Wednesday she reiterated her buy rating on Northland Cranberries Inc.
-- The analyst said she discounted a "story on the Street" that Northland will be facing competition from a new cranberry-based juice drink from Chile.
-- "We believe this bear story is unfounded," Wittenburg said in a report.

-- She said she believes the cranberry harvest in Chile is "actually quite poor," and added most of the cranberry concentrate produced from that harvest is contracted to Northland and two other cranberry processors.
-- Northland, a cranberry grower, is rolling out nationally a 100 percent cranberry juice blend product.
-- "We view the recent pullback in Northland's stock price as an excellent buying opportunity," Wittenburg said.
-- Northland Cranberries shares were off 5/8 at 15-5/8.
